input_policy: Old scenes retain exact prior 25 views; additional scenes use consecutive middle 25 cached SAM3 views, selected by frame ordinal before naming/GT. Full frozen geometry and estimated trajectory retained.
scope: Fresh VLM and optional CLIP inference plus fresh CPU fusion/backfill, from cached SAM3 and frozen geometry. Not raw RGB-D end-to-end timing. Object naming association only, no point ownership/class changes.

arms.A: All original crops, Qwen naming in parallel with fresh CPU fusion, original backfill.
arms.B: Fresh fusion then predicted-object crop grouping, at most 3 distinct representative views; if no 2-frame strict majority, infer all remaining eligible crops of that object. No calls for crops that cannot backfill or objects with fewer than 2 eligible frames.
arms.C: B plus on-demand CLIP visual check for eligible crop associations with share <0.8 or a second object >=30 points and >=0.15 share. Use up to 2 non-ambiguous distinct-frame prototypes per involved object. Reject association if own cosine <0.70 or own-rival margin <0.05; no prototype keeps geometry; no new associations or ownership edits.

representatives: Max mask_pixels*geometric_share first; then largest angular separation among crops at least half the best remaining quality. No GT/model labels used for selection.

clip.crop: same saved VLM crop, RGB preprocessing; visual encoder only, no text encoder

cache: Cold per arm/run. No pre-existing VLM outputs or CLIP features used for measured inference. Preserve original source frame IDs and deduplicate votes. Cache namespace binds geometry, memberships, model, prompt and crop hashes.
evaluation: Seal all predictions before GT. Report call counts, actual post-SAM3 tail wall time including model process startup and lost fusion/naming overlap, peak GPU/RAM, all-array map parity, exact naming agreement/coverage and independently projected GT naming diagnostic where available. Existing taxonomy aliases fixed from repository, unrecognized names abstain; no GT-tuned thresholds.
promotion: Experimental only. No production pipeline change or claim of 3D instance accuracy gain.
